reviewer: Claude (author of the parent PDM1SPIHID adapter; independent of this design)

reviewed.against: parent adapter 74a22b56 + core002; pinned PureDarwin e7aa00a IOHIDFamily and xnu in sources/puredarwin-m1-desktop

verdict: APPROVE DESIGN002 FOR KERNEL SOURCE IMPLEMENTATION, subject to implementation conditions M1, M2 and M4. These must be enforced in code and covered by the required harness. L1, L2 and L3 from my 001 review are resolved at design level. This approves a design, not code. A source review of the implementation, root's SDK/KC/raw-source binding, the exact host contract and supervisor tests are still required before any boot.

resolved.L1: Both parent and child set and read back RegisterService=kOSBooleanFalse before their base start, on the T2 path only. The fallible timer arm happens in the gated commit before either registration. Permanent pins are taken under the gate. Parent then child registration uses kIOServiceAsynchronous outside the gate. No false return or rollback follows commit. A keyboard-only fallback registers only the parent and keeps T2 failed. Precommit failure registers nothing and withdraws the unpublished child before balancing the parent once. Source check: keeping the property false after commit is safe. Only IOHIDDevice::start (IOHIDDevice.cpp:476) and IOHIDEventService::start (IOHIDEventService.cpp:375, its own property only) read RegisterService. The interface property copy list in publishProperties (IOHIDDevice.cpp ~651-678) does not include it, and createInterface (L1964-1987) attaches and starts nubs unconditionally, so the keyboard and child interfaces and event drivers still register.
resolved.L2: PDM1SPIInterfaceID is OSNumber(32) value 2, read as exactly 4 bytes 02000000. ReportDescriptor is exactly 110 bytes matching this boot's acquisition. PDM1TrackpadChildStateV1 is a 32-byte immutable record with an explicit admission tuple. Root's gate 2aa7f7db adds bounded io_registry_entry_get_property_bytes reads with NoResources/IPCError/zero-length handled as identity failure, and says the byte RPC cannot check type, matching my P1-P3.
resolved.L3: One explicit permanent parent pin and, if prepared, one child pin plus childOwned, never released. Committed stop wrappers for both devices disable routing and opens and record TEARDOWN_DEFERRED without calling HID base stop, quiesce's destructive path or disposeTransport, even at zero dispatch count. handleStop, disposeTransport and free are destructive only in never-committed state. An unexpected committed free is refused and recorded, never resurrected. Harness mutants must kill the dropped staging and dropped barriers. Bounded to one cohort per boot by the CAS probe latch.
resolved.added_and_correct: Direct-open guards for staged devices, which are visible in the registry but not matched (handleOpen and parent newUserClient refused before commit and after stop; child raw user clients always refused, using an atomic phase read with no arbitration-lock/gate inversion). Stale ready properties are removed before a fault replacement, and a visible OSData is never mutated.

implementation_conditions.text: The admission guards (handleOpen and parent newUserClient) must apply only on the T2 path. In T1 or ordinary native mode the parent still registers inside super::start before its timer arm, so keyboard clients can legitimately open then. A guard keyed on the T2 'commit' phase would regress the keyboard there. Harness: with no child token, parent handleOpen and newUserClient behave exactly as the base implementation.

IOKit runs termination callbacks on work loops. terminateWorker calls actionWillTerminate and actionDidTerminate through _workLoopAction(victim), and actionStop through _workLoopAction(provider) (IOService.cpp:2512-2526, ~3272, ~3377). So child->stop(parent) runs on the termination thread holding the parent's transportLoop gate. The stop wrapper's gated sink-clear is then a same-thread recursive runAction and safe. No child hook may wait for another thread that needs transportLoop: no wait for the dispatch count to drain, and no commandSleep without a wake source on the same gate. Harness: run the committed child stop wrapper with the gate already held; it must finish without blocking.

On direct child termination the child's own willTerminate is not called; only its clients' are, on the victim's loop. The child's willTerminate fires only when the parent is terminated, which is refused. The operative sink-clear is therefore the stop wrapper. Between client teardown and child->stop, poll can still dispatch to the child. In the pinned IOHIDFamily this is benign: IOHIDInterface::close clears _interruptAction inside its command gate created on the inherited transportLoop (IOHIDInterface.cpp ~360-390), and IOHIDInterface::handleReport drops reports when it is NULL (L502-516). Both are serialized with poll, so the check-then-call there cannot race. Optional hardening: routing also skips a child whose isInactive() is set in termination phase 1, so the T2 state goes not-ready earlier.

After framework detach, child->getWorkLoop() returns NULL, because IOService::getWorkLoop resolves via getProvider() (IOService.cpp:1381-1389). The child must not override getWorkLoop. It must use only IOHIDDevice's retained _workLoop and never call the async report path, since handleReportWithTimeAsync calls getWorkLoop()->addEventSource (IOHIDDevice.cpp:1934-1950), or any helper that resolves getWorkLoop() dynamically after stop. Delivery stays the synchronous handleReport from poll, as designed.

carried_notes: N1 (from 001): record the actual element and interface allocation outcome for the 1752-byte report 0x44 in the T2 result rather than assuming it is small.
N2 (from 001): a T2 lifecycle qualifier must take its log-order expectations from the implemented source, not from my T1 keyboard-descriptor-first mistake.

Admission tuple: the gate must read the child's own PDM1TrackpadChildStateV1 copy (the provider relation identifies the child). The parent and IOResources copies are diagnostics only, as DESIGN002 states.
scope: Read-only design review against the pinned IOHIDFamily/xnu sources and the parent adapter. No edits, builds, SSH or hardware.
